hits.about: Al Ameera Village is a unique masterpiece featuring five signature skyscrapers and 9-storey 44 heritage-styled residential towers, located in the serene suburb of Al Yasmeen. The design of the buildings in the historical style makes this complex unique and authentic. For sale are elegant studios and 1-2 bedroom apartments. Each residence boasts private balconies, providing a perfect spot for residents to relax and enjoy picturesque views of the city scenery. This exceptional residential complex offers a comprehensive range of amenities and luxuries, making it an ideal dream home for discerning buyers.Al Ameera Village is creasted to cater to all aspects of modern living, with facilities that include kindergartens, shopping and office centers, stores, cafes, parks, sports facilities, and playgrounds. The complex is distinguished by its unique layout, featuring numerous walking and jogging paths that promote a healthy and active lifestyle. Its location ensures proximity to children’s development centers, international schools, and established residential communities, making it a perfect setting for families.Strategically situated next to Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Road, Al Ameera Village offers easy access to key destinations: Al Hamidiya Park is 3 minutes away, Ajman Beach - 15 minutes, Al Zorah Natural Reserve - 16 minutes, Ajman City Center - 18 minutes, and Amina Hospital is 19 minutes away.Al Ameera Village combines modern convenience with traditional charm, providing a serene yet connected lifestyle in the heart of Al Yasmeen.
